messages:
marta: Hey team — customer report: sustained burst of embedding requests (~120 req/s) started seeing 502s and sporadic 504s from our Hosted API around 08:12 UTC. They pasted a couple trace IDs: trace=trc-84a2, trc-84a7.

marta: Quick repro curl they ran:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/emb-32x/embeddings -d '{"input": "long text repeated..."}'
```

tyler: thx. saw a small uptick in upstream 5xxs on ingress between 08:11-08:15. flank of client retries + large payloads. grabbing envoy logs now.

samir: stacktrace snippet from envoy logs:
```
[2026-03-17T08:12:28Z] router reset reason: connection failure, upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_failure, transport_failure}
[2026-03-17T08:12:28Z] stream closed: 504 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers.
```

samir: also saw a handful of GOAWAY frames from the auth-enrichment pool at the same time — upstream (auth-enrich) reported brief overload and closed HTTP/2 streams.

jess: is this the authcache TTL rotation we rolled yesterday? could be synchronized cache invalidations + burst -> auth-enrich gets thundering herd.

marta: customer says they don't retry aggressively; they do batch many items per request (embedding batch ~128). might be client-side chunking + our upstream backpressure.

tyler: repro steps I'm running: 1) simulate 100 parallel curl clients posting embedding batches of size 100, 2) sample headers show X-Trace-ID and X-Billing-CTX, 3) measure 502/504 surface. initial run produced 502s ~7% at peak.

tyler: quick mitigation options:
- temporarily increase auth-enrich instance count (scaled to +2)
- bump envoy upstream connection pool (max_connections) for auth-enrich route to reduce connect churn
- enable request-level jitter and backoff for clients (ask customer)

samir: tried scaling auth-enrich -> errors dropped to ~1.2%. envoy logs show fewer GOAWAYs. but still some 504s due to queued request timeouts in the ingress queue.

jess: could be ingress proxy h2 stream window exhaustion when many long-lived streams (embedding responses). also see increased tokenization time on model side increasing tail latency.

marta: customer provided response headers from failing request:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
server: envoy
x-request-id: r-9a7c
x-upstream-time: 0.003
x-proxy-err: upstream-reset
```

marta: captured a full trace (trc-84a2) in trace UI — shows request made it to edge, then auth-enrich returned 200 but connection to model-gateway timed out while waiting for kv cache warmup. lots of small timings.

tyler: immediate ops playbook applied: 1) scaled auth-enrich, 2) increased envoy per-route max_concurrent_streams to 512 for that upstream, 3) applied a conservative 2s increase to proxy_idle_timeout. monitoring dashboards now.

support-ops-bot: Incident ticket created: SUP-2026-1149 (high-volume 502/504 bursts). Pager oncall: @oncall-bot

oncall-bot: paging oncall (eng-sre) — severity P2 unless customer pushes.

marta: customer still seeing occasional 502s but latency improved. plan: implement a short-term client guidance doc (reduce batch size to 64, add small jittered retry on 502/504 with exponential backoff) and medium-term: add randomized TTL refresh for authcache to avoid synchronized invalidations.

samir: also adding a safety guard in envoy config: route-level upstream_connection_backoff and increase circuit-breaker thresholds for pending requests. will stage in canary tonight.

jess: note for product: consider adding quota for very large single-batch embedding requests to prevent single-client waves causing upstream saturation.

marta: can someone paste a short blurb for customer response (what we changed + recommended client workarounds)? I can send it.

tyler: paste for customer: "We observed brief overload on our auth enrichment service during a high-concurrency burst which caused some upstream resets and gateway 502/504 errors. Immediate mitigations scaled the enrichment service and relaxed some ingress HTTP/2 limits, which reduced errors. Recommended short-term actions: reduce embedding batch size (128->64), enable client-side jittered retry on 502/504, and we will follow up with a patch to randomize cache refresh timing. We will keep you updated and have an incident ticket SUP-2026-1149."

marta: sending that now. I'll follow up after canary completes. :thumbsup:

jess: small action item list in case notes:
- samir: deploy envoy canary with higher max_concurrent_streams and backoff config (tonight)
- tyler: monitor SUP-2026-1149 and update dashboards
- marta: customer comms + recommend SDK doc changes for embedding batching/retries

marta: closing thread for now, will reopen if error rate spikes again.
